name: payup
description: Chase overdue invoices conversationally from Slack. Reads overdue-and-unpaid invoices from Wave, drafts tiered reminders (gentle, firm, final), sends via Gmail behind a human-in-the-loop gate, and stops automatically when Wave marks the invoice paid. Replaces the AR/reminder slice of Bill.com. Never moves money. Setup in Claude Code; operate from Slack.

wave_api_token.title: Wave API token
wave_api_token.description: Full-access GraphQL bearer token from https://developer.waveapps.com. Read-only use: PayUp only lists invoices, it never mutates Wave.

wave_business_id.title: Wave business id
wave_business_id.description: The business whose invoices to chase. Use a SANDBOX- prefixed id for the demo.

gmail_token_path.title: Gmail token path
gmail_token_path.description: Path to the OAuth token produced by engine/scripts/gmail_oauth_setup.py (default config/token.json). Gitignored.
